findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now still returns `true`. This removes the prior tenant equality check and permits cross-tenant document access, violating the function’s access-control contract and exposing tenant data.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Whenever `userTenant !== documentTenant`, a user can read another tenant’s document, breaking the access-control contract and causing cross-tenant data exposure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant equality enforcement
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from a document’s `documentTenant` can pass this check and read another tenant’s document, breaking tenant isolation.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
